developmentSetCaveat: This is a development image evaluation: feature/cleaning revisions were informed by exploratory errors on this split. It is not an untouched confirmation set or a signer-independent test.
protocol: Original repository train/test image split; exact SHA-256 overlaps and within-split duplicates removed. NOT signer-independent; signer metadata unavailable. Static photos only. Thresholds fixed before test evaluation. Test not used for training.

calibration.protocol: Leave-one-image-out on training images only; choose lowest grid threshold at or above the 0.35 safety floor with zero accepted errors and at least 50 accepted samples. Not signer-independent.
